nodes.description: Public address of the current winner; written in unlockSecret when the blockhash-derived value is divisible by 5, and read by claimPrize for the payout.
Owner of DrainMe, set to msg.sender in the DranMe constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier and manipulateSecret.
Hardcoded target address invoked with a low-level value call in callFirstTarget.
Hardcoded target address invoked with a low-level value call in callSecondTarget.
Array of player addresses, appended in becomePlayer and read by getPlayerCount.
Mapping of approved players used by the onlyPlayers modifier guarding several payable entry points.
Secret value set by setSecret and compared in checkSecret and guessSeed.
Public uint array used as pseudo-random seed; its entries and length are attacker-writable via setSeed/addSeed.
Declared public uint256 array that is never written or read.
Payable constructor-like function that assigns owner = msg.sender; callable by anyone at any time.
Constant function returning seed.length.
Payable onlyOwner function writing the secret state variable from the _secret argument.
Constant function returning players.length.
Constant function returning address(this).balance.
Payable function requiring >=0.02 ether that pushes msg.sender into players and whitelists it.
Payable onlyPlayers function that conditionally transfers funds to msg.sender when msg.sender != owner or unlockSecret() succeeds.
Private function deriving a value from keccak256(blockhash(block.number-1)) and setting winner = msg.sender when it is divisible by 5.
Payable onlyPlayers function performing firstTarget.call.value(msg.value)() with no return-value or reentrancy guard.
Payable onlyPlayers function performing secondTarget.call.value(msg.value)() with no return-value or reentrancy guard.
Payable onlyPlayers function that writes an arbitrary value at an arbitrary index of the seed array.
Payable onlyPlayers function assigning seed.length = _add, allowing unbounded storage-length manipulation.
Payable onlyPlayers function returning _seed/(seed[0]*seed[1]) with an unchecked early return making the subsequent owner reassignment unreachable.
Payable onlyPlayers function comparing msg.value with the secret state variable.
Payable onlyOwner function sending 1 wei to owner through a low-level call.
Payable onlyWinner function transferring the whole contract balance to winner.
Empty payable fallback function of DrainMe, invoked by all value transfers and low-level calls.
Hardcoded DrainMe instance pointer at 0xB620CeE6B52f96f3C6b253E6eEa556Aa2d214a99 used by the attacker contract.
Owner of the Hack contract, set to msg.sender in its constructor and checked in putHere/test/take.
Constructor of the Hack contract assigning owner = msg.sender.
Payable function requiring >=0.03 ether and msg.sender == owner; it accepts ether into the attacker contract.
Payable attack driver that derives a value from blockhash, calls DrainMe.DranMe, becomePlayer, manipulateSecret and claimPrize, then drains its own balance to msg.sender.
Owner-restricted function transferring the whole balance to msg.sender.
Empty payable fallback of Hack that receives re-entrant value transfers from DrainMe.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, whitelisting, winner selection and fund transfers inside DrainMe.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and final transfer in the Hack contract.
Unchecked low-level value call firstTarget.call.value(msg.value)() executed before any state/accounting effect.
Unchecked low-level value call secondTarget.call.value(msg.value)() to an attacker-influenced target.
Low-level owner.call.value(1 wei)() without checking success or guarding reentrancy.
winner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the entire balance to a caller-influenced address.
msg.sender.transfer(amount) forwards value to the caller inside the payable onlyPlayers entry point.
contr.claimPrize() external call made from Hack.test, which triggers the DrainMe payout to the Hack contract.
seed.length = _add lets a player arbitrarily expand storage array length, enabling denial of service/out-of-gas states.
Unchecked arithmetic _seed / (seed[0]*seed[1]) with attacker-controlled seed entries can overflow/underflow and divide by zero.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) in Hack.take sends the entire balance to the owner.
contr.becomePlayer.value(0.02 ether)() external payable call registering the Hack contract as a player.
contr.manipulateSecret.value(0.01 ether)() external payable call executing unlockSecret and setting winner to the Hack contract.
contr.DranMe() external call that re-executes the constructor-like function and overwrites owner with the Hack contract.
_secret argument of setSecret written into the secret state variable.
_index argument of setSeed used as the array index written in the seed array.
_value argument of setSeed written into seed[_index].
_add argument of addSeed used to set seed.length.
_seed argument of guessSeed used as numerator of the unchecked division.
Local amount initialised to 0 and used as the transferred value in manipulateSecret.
Local hash = keccak256(blockhash(block.number-1)) used to derive the winner decision.
Local uint256 secret derived from hash that shadows the state variable and decides the winner.
Local hash in Hack.test derived from blockhash(block.number-1).
Local uint256 secret in Hack.test derived from hash that branches the exploit with secret%5==0.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner inside DranMe, allowing any caller to seize ownership.
msg.sender is pushed into players and whitelisted in approvedPlayers in becomePlayer.
msg.sender is compared with owner and receives the transfer in manipulateSecret.
msg.sender becomes winner in unlockSecret when the blockhash-derived value is divisible by 5.
take transfers the Hack contract balance directly to msg.sender.
test gates the exploit on msg.sender == owner and finally transfers balance to msg.sender.
Hack owner is set from msg.sender in the Hack constructor.
callFirstTarget performs the unchecked low-level value call to firstTarget.
callSecondTarget performs the unchecked low-level value call to secondTarget.
winPrize issues owner.call.value(1 wei)() with no reentrancy guard.
claimPrize transfers the full contract balance to winner without clearing state first.
manipulateSecret transfers value to msg.sender after unlockSecret mutates winner.
test calls contr.claimPrize which pays out to the Hack contract.
test forwards 0.02 ether to contr.becomePlayer to become a whitelisted player.
test forwards 0.01 ether to contr.manipulateSecret to trigger unlockSecret.
test calls contr.DranMe(), resetting DrainMe owner to the Hack contract.
addSeed assigns seed.length from attacker-controlled _add without bounds.
guessSeed computes _seed/(seed[0]*seed[1]) with attacker-controlled operands.
take performs a value transfer to msg.sender as its final action.
setSecret writes the secret state variable.
checkSecret compares msg.value with the stored secret.
guessSeed compares the computed value with the stored secret.
getLength returns the length of the seed array.
setSeed writes an element of the seed array.
addSeed rewrites the length of the seed array.
guessSeed reads seed[0] and seed[1] in a multiplication that can overflow.
getPlayerCount returns players.length.
becomePlayer appends msg.sender to the players array.
onlyPlayers modifier consults approvedPlayers for manipulateSecret.
onlyPlayers modifier consults approvedPlayers for callFirstTarget.
onlyPlayers modifier consults approvedPlayers for callSecondTarget.
onlyPlayers modifier consults approvedPlayers for setSeed.
onlyPlayers modifier consults approvedPlayers for addSeed.
onlyPlayers modifier consults approvedPlayers for guessSeed.
onlyPlayers modifier consults approvedPlayers for checkSecret.
unlockSecret writes winner = msg.sender based on a miner-influenceable blockhash.
claimPrize pays the entire balance to the winner address.
guessSeed reassigns owner = winner, letting the winner take over ownership.
firstTarget is the destination of the low-level value call.
secondTarget is the destination of the low-level value call.
contr is the DrainMe instance on which claimPrize is invoked.
contr is the DrainMe instance on which becomePlayer is invoked.
contr is the DrainMe instance on which manipulateSecret is invoked.
contr is the DrainMe instance on which DranMe is re-invoked to reset owner.
setSecret is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading owner.
winPrize is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading owner.
manipulateSecret compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
The low-level call to firstTarget can re-enter the DrainMe fallback function.
The low-level call to secondTarget can re-enter the DrainMe fallback function.
owner.call.value(1 wei)() can invoke the fallback of the receiving contract.
winner.transfer can invoke the Hack fallback when winner is the attacker contract.
msg.sender.transfer in manipulateSecret can invoke the caller fallback.
Hack.take forwards the balance to msg.sender, which may re-enter the Hack fallback.
contr.claimPrize re-enters DrainMe and executes its fallback upon value transfer.
The _secret parameter is written into the secret state variable.
The _index parameter indexes the seed array write.
The _value parameter is stored at seed[_index].
The _add parameter becomes the new seed.length.
The _seed parameter is used as the numerator of the unchecked division.
The local amount is the value forwarded to msg.sender in manipulateSecret.
The local hash derived from blockhash controls the winner selection.
The local secret derived from hash determines whether winner is set.
The local hash in test is derived from blockhash and branches the exploit.
The local secret in test decides the secret%5==0 exploit branch.

normalization_plan.reason: The _secret parameter of setSecret is a transient argument that is immediately stored into the secret state variable, so it can be merged into the setSecret function node.
The _index parameter of setSeed only indexes the seed array write and can be merged into the setSeed function node.
The _value parameter of setSeed is a transient argument written into seed[_index] and can be merged into the setSeed function node.
The _add parameter of addSeed directly becomes seed.length and can be merged into the addSeed function node.
The _seed parameter of guessSeed is only used in the division expression and can be merged into the guessSeed function node.
The local amount in manipulateSecret is a constant 0 used only for the transfer and can be merged into the manipulateSecret function node.
The local hash in unlockSecret is derived from blockhash and is local to the winner-selection logic, so it can be merged into unlockSecret.
The local secret in unlockSecret shadows the state variable and is only used for the modulo branch, so it can be merged into unlockSecret.
The local hash in Hack.test only exists to compute the exploit branch and can be merged into the test function node.
The local secret in Hack.test is only used for the secret%5==0 check and can be merged into the test function node.
